claim_en: THE FOUR-TOKEN LITURGY. Rest, zikhronot, shofarot, the day; malkhuyot adjoined; the order dispute with Usha; Onkelos's broken cry.
THE SHOFAR. Instrument, plain blasts, three-of-three, all from the Jubilee.
THE DAY ATONES. Without rites or offerings; only the penitent by 'but'; warning and punishment for work.
KARET IS DESTRUCTION. The effect's content; the five afflictions; not the weekly Sabbath.
THE ADDITION. Profane to holy on every rest; no karet or warning on it; the fast's warning from a redundant punishment.
THE FIRST SEVEN. Sukkah for Sukkot only; chagigah for God, sukkah for man; sanctify with food, drink, clothing.

source: Sifra, Emor, Section 12 5-10 + Chapter 15 1-5 + Onkelos Lev 23:36
claim_en: THE INTERMEDIATE DAYS. Work bounded by 'it'; the order rule with invalidity; the do-not-delay timer after three festivals in order.
THE INGATHERING. Intercalate for the ingathering of most fruits; make-up all seven.
THE FOUR SPECIES. Bound disputed; yours not stolen (the ship); day, first day even Sabbath; the identifications and counts; whole taking; Onkelos naming them.
THE CHAGIGAH. One day with seven-day make-up, inside the season only.
THE SUKKAH. Dwell as you live; nights by the Lev 8 analogy; women out, minors in; any material by the strict-to-lenient meta-rule; Onkelos rules clouds.
MOSES TAUGHT. Each festival's laws in its season; the season fixed for all public offerings; Onkelos's 'order... and taught.'
